text:
anya: Hey team — updated mockups for the Usage & Billing page. Main changes: stacked spend chart (org vs project), token breakdown by model, invoices microcopy tweak, CSV export, and an accessible color palette. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE (new artboard). Looking for quick UX + PM + finance signoff before the next sprint planning. Thoughts?

miguel: Nice. I really like the org/project toggle. My worry: the token breakdown looks heavy. Can we collapse it by default on org view?

zhao: Totally doable. If we collapse by default we should make it an opt-in API to avoid extra DB work for list pages. Suggest an `include_token_breakdown=true` query param. Example: `GET /v1/usage?project_id=...&include_token_breakdown=true`

sam: From finance side — invoices need clearer billing period and last4 of payment method visible on the list. CSV export: include committed discounts and reserved capacity rows (these are getting lost in the current export).

katie: Accessibility nit: the red used on the spend chart is ~3.9:1 contrast — fails AA for normal text. Recommend darker red or patterned fills for colorblind users. Also add screen-reader descriptions for each slice.

anya: Good catches — I'll update the palette & add aria-labels. For collapse behavior, proposal: default collapsed on org view, expanded on project view (users on a project want detail).

miguel: Also thinking about chart types — could we do a combo: bars for token counts and a line for $/day to show cost velocity? Feels clearer than stacked area for some customers.

zhao: Rendering bar+line client-side for many projects might be expensive. Suggest server-side downsampling into fixed time buckets (hour/day) and return pre-aggregated series. That keeps frontend fast.

sam: Another invoice edge: adjustments/credits sometimes appear as negative line items and the hover total used to round weirdly. Need explicit rounding rules and a visible "invoice adjustments" section so customers don't email support.

design-bot: Design review checklist updated: color contrast (FAIL), keyboard nav (PASS), aria labels (FAIL), CSV export presence (PASS), mobile layout (PASS).

anya: I'll push an updated Figma and a tiny prototype (chart + CSV export) by EOD. Who can pair on the CSV schema? @sam @zhao

miguel: :thumbsup: I'll schedule a 15-min sync after lunch to align scope.

zhao: I can pair on the CSV schema at 3pm. Will bring sample query and suggested downsampling shape.

sam: 3pm works. I'll bring finance CSV samples and a test invoice with credits.

anya: Awesome — thanks everyone. Will follow up with the updated artboard and a short changelog in this thread. :sparkles:
